title: Girl Realizes She Killed Her Best Friend
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation into the death of Ohio teen Halia Culbertson. Authorities arrested her best friend, Bryanna Barozzini, after investigators determined she was involved in a heated argument outside a convenience store in Columbus. Bryanna had already left the area when officers arrived, prompting them to go to her home to arrest her before questioning her about the incident. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
